cells.gaps: No figures of use or review published in the last three years: the Northern Corridor ministers' 900-fold traffic rise for the partner states dates from 9 November 2023, and no figures of South Sudan's own traffic are found.
cells.note: An EAC official said in November 2026 that South Sudan has put the One Network Area roaming framework into effect and that it cut cross-border costs, which answers question 3, not question 4. The only figures of use, the ministers' communique of 9 November 2023, are now more than three years old, so stage 4.
